List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on

†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Powers to DGCA
*361. SHRI C. PERUMAL: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether Government have proposed
to give more teeth to the Directorate General
of Civil Aviation (DGCA);
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Loss of fuel due to delay in landing of
flights
*362. SHRI SHANTARAM
LAXMAN NAIK: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether  it is a fact that commercial
flight aircrafts have to hover over important
airports like Mumbai, Delhi and Kolkata
for  30 to 60 minutes both during morning
and evening hours before landing;
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
reasons therefor; and
(c) the loss in terms of fuel, if estimated,
due to the same?
Development of Ranchi Airport
†*363. SHRI AJAY MAROO: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether the Airports Authority of
India has formulated any plan to upgrade
the airport at Ranchi, the Capital of
Jharkhand, to international level;
(b) if so, by when the plan would be
taken up alongwith the estimated cost
thereof;
(c) whether State Government is
extending its cooperation to the scheme;
and
(d) the number of years the scheme
would take for its completion?
Menace of touts at airports
*364. SHRIMATI VIPLOVE
THAKUR : Will the Minister of CIVIL
AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are aware of
the general complaint of the foreign tourists
being cheated by touts operating at various
airports in the country particularly at
Bhuntar Airport, Himachal Pradesh;

113
(b) if so, whether they are reportedly
acting in connivance with the taxi operators,
trolley retrieving staff and other subordinate
staff;
(c) if so, whether any enquiry has been
initiated in this matter;
(d) if so, the results thereof; and
(e) the follow-up action taken or
proposed to be taken by Government
thereon?
Assistance to AP under Accelerated
Irrigation Benefit Programme
*365. SHRI SYED AZEEZ PASHA:
Will the Minister of WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Andhra Pradesh State
Government have asked the Centre to
enhance the allocation of Rs. 8000 crore
per year under the Accelerated Irrigation
Benefit Programme in the next five years;
and
(b) if so, the details thereof and
Government's reaction thereto?
Variations in rates of VAT between
States
*366. SHRIMATI N.P. DURGA: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that some
variations in rates of VAT between State-
to-State still exist due to some of the
decisions taken by the Empowered
Committee;
(b) if so, the details of decisions because
of which there is a variation in VAT rates in
some of the States;
(c) whether it is also a fact that some of
the States have deviated from the EC
approved rate structure;
(d) if so, the details of States which
have deviated from this; and
(e) what action the Ministry is taking
or proposed to take to pursuade the States
to follow the EC approved VAT structure?
Protection to SSI of Gujarat
*367. SHRI SURYAKANTBHAI
ACHARYA:
SHRI JAYANTILAL BAROT:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the request of the State
Government of Gujarat for rationalization
of duty structure in respect of drugs and
pharmaceuticals by bringing down the rate
of excise duty from 16 per cent to 8 per
cent has been turned down;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor;
(c) whether any alternative steps are
being taken by Government to protect the
adversely affected small scale industries of
Gujarat; and
(d) if so, the details thereof?
Utilization of amount under IEPF
*368. SHRI C. RAMACHAND-
RAIAH: Will the Minister of COMPANY
AFFAIRS be pleased to state:
(a) the steps being taken to utilize the
amount available under the Investor
Education and Protection Fund (IEPF);
(b) whether the amount sanctioned and
disbursed to the Investors Association is
very late in a financial year;
(c) if so, the reasons therefor;
(d) the number of proposals received
from the Investors Association during the
last one year;

114
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
(e) the funds sanctioned for the year
2005-06 and the programme chalked out
for the year 2005-06;
(f) the status of the total fund credited
to IEPF till now;
(g) whether Government are considering
to transfer the said fund to SEBI; and
(h) if so, the details thereof?
Restoration and maintenance work of
monuments to private agencies
*369. SHRI DHARAM PAL
SABHARWAL: Will the Minister of
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the
Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) has
decided to outsource the conservation of
monuments by giving these monuments to
private agencies for restoration and
maintenance work;
(b) if so, the reasons therefor and the
steps taken to rectify the same; and
(c) the steps taken to ensure that
restoration and maintenance work of these
monuments is done departmentally?
Rehabilitation of people displaced due
to construction of dams
†*370. SHRI DATTA MEGHE: Will
the Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that people
displaced due to the construction of dams
starting from Bhakra dam to the dam
constructed on Narmada have not been
fully rehabilitated;
(b) if so, the reasons for not rehabilitating
these people till now; and
(c) by when, the displaced people of
Narmada River dam would be fully
rehabilitated?
Amendment of loan grant ratio to
States
†*371. SHRI LALIT KISHORE
CHATURVEDI: Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the details regarding basis for
providing 70 per cent loan and 30 per cent
grant to States;
(b) whether any State has demanded
for amending loan-grant ratio; and
(c) if so, the demand of State
Governments in this regard and the decision
expected to be taken thereon?
Promotion of Buddhist sites
*372. MS. PRAMILA BOHIDAR:
SHRI B.J. PANDA:
Will the Minister of CULTURE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
launch a concerted campaign for promotion
of Buddhist sites of the country especially
to attract overseas tourists;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) what are the details of the Buddhist
sites in Orissa where the upgradation of
the infrastructure is proposed to be taken
up under this project?
Erosion of Ganga and its tributaries
*373. SHRI MUKUL ROY: Will the
Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the Farakka Barrage
Authority is mainly responsible for the

115
serious and continuous erosion by the
Ganga and its tributaries like Mahananda,
Fodhar, etc., in the districts of Malda and
Murshidabad during the last three to four
years;
(b) how much fund has been released
by the Central Government and actually
utilized by the Farakka Barrage Authority
(F.B.A.) during the last three years for
erosion-protection work; and
(c) what are the plans for rehabilitation
of the families who have lost their homes
and lands due to the erosion?
Common currency unit of ASEAN
countries
*374. SHRIMATI SHOBHANA
BHARTIA : Will the Minister of
FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government are likely to
step up efforts to join the league of  ASEAN
countries that are working on a plan to
evolve a common currency unit;
(b) if so, whether India has been kept
out of the plan of common currency unit;
(c) if so, what are the reasons and what
steps Government are considering to be
included in the formation of a common
currency unit;
(d) to what extent the country has been
successful; and
(e) whether any final decision has been
taken in this regard?
Allocation of kerosene to Gujarat
*375. SHRI KANJIBHAI PATEL: Will
the Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether the State Government of
Gujarat have demanded for increase in
allocation of kerosene; and
(b) if so, the reaction of Government
thereto?
Revision of Target Plus scheme for
carmakers
*376. SHRIMATI SYEDA
ANWARA TAIMUR:
SHRI VIJAY J. DARDA:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
revise its Target Plus scheme that offered
carmakers fiscal benefits on high export
shipments;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) by when, the proposal is likely to
be implemented?
External aid for States
*377. SHRI LALIT SURI: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) the number of externally aided
development projects at present being
executed in the country in the Central, State
and multi-State spheres with cost thereof
in each category;
(b) how the States access to external aid
for their projects;
(c) whether there is any mechanism to
monitor the progress of such projects to
ensure that no undue delay is caused in
their execution;
(d) if so, the details thereof;
(e) if not, whether there is any proposal
to provide for a monitoring agency for the
purpose; and

Outstanding dues of banks against
States
*378. SHRI DARA SINGH: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether the dues of certain
Nationalized Banks are outstanding against
some State Governments;
(b) if so, the details thereof, till date,
State-wise;
(c) the reasons for the dues remaining
outstanding; and
(d) the steps taken/proposed to be taken
for recovery of the said dues?
Drainage of rain water in N.E. Region
*379. SHRI MATILAL SARKAR: Will
the Minister of WATER RESOURCES be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made any
assessment on the quantity of rain water
in percentage that drains away down the
hills and crop-fields during every rainy
season, particularly in the North-Eastern
Region;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) if not, the reasons therefor; and
(d) what steps Government propose to
take to check the useless drainage and
upgrade the water catchment programme?
Exploration target of ONGC
*380. PROF. P.J. KURIEN: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have set up
any specific targets for ONGC in the
matter of exploration;
(b) if so, what are the targets set up for
the current year for ONGC to complete
exploration and surveys in our territories;
and
(c) to what extent the targets have been
achieved?

Development of Jabalpur airport

Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be

Government of Madhya Pradesh had
provided land free for the development of
airport at Jabalpur;
(b) the number of works like terminal
building, night landing facility etc.
completed so far after acquiring the land;
and
(c) by when, the above construction
work will be completed?
Clearance of purchase of aircraft by
AAC
2570. SHRI ALI ANWAR:
SHRI SHARAD YADAV:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:

the Aircraft Acquisition Committee (AAC)

by Jet Airways and Indigo Airlines during
the last two years;

declared before the AAC; and

the source of funding of the aircrafts and if
so, the details thereof?
Cancellation of flights of Indian
Airlines

the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) the average hour a day an air-craft
remains above the ground;

delayed or get cancelled in the month of
July, 2006;

cancellation in such a big number; and
(d) the remedy that Government
propose to take to avoid the change in
Schedule?

†2572. SHRI SAMAN PATHAK: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be

(a) whether a proposal for upgradation
of Bagdogra airport into international
airport is under consideration of
Government;
(b) if so, the status of this proposal
alongwith the details thereof; and

Air services in Chhattisgarh

Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be

(a) whether the State Government of
Chhattisgarh have submitted a proposal to
the Central Government for getting
approval for introducing air service in the
interiors of the State;

news reports stating that many airlines force

private sector managements of strict action

improving Mumbai and Delhi airports;
(b) what was the context in which this
warning was made;
(c) whether Government are unhappy
with the lack of progress; and

(b) whether any study has been made

about because license has been given to too
many flights to operate from Delhi airport

this situation?

leading to dislike and rejection by the

therefor?

monuments;
